landing.hero.title: Your health records,
landing.hero.subtitle: PARIKSHAN organizes your medical reports, explains lab results in plain language, tracks trends over time, reviews medications, and answers your questions — grounded in your own records, in English and Hindi.
landing.hero.trustLine: Private by design · Not a medical device · You control your data
landing.features.title: One platform for your entire health story
landing.features.subtitle: Every feature is built around clarity, provenance, and consent — not hype.
landing.features.docIntel.title: Medical document intelligence
landing.features.docIntel.body: Upload lab reports, prescriptions, and scans. PARIKSHAN extracts text with OCR, classifies the document, and pulls out structured results with their original units and reference ranges.
landing.features.explain.title: Plain-language explanations
landing.features.explain.body: Turn dense medical jargon into understandable summaries, glossaries, and questions to ask your clinician — always traceable to the source page.
landing.features.trends.title: Honest health trends
landing.features.trends.body: See how your lab values move over time, with reference-range bands and source attribution. We only chart values you actually have.
landing.features.meds.title: Medication & interaction review
landing.features.meds.body: Keep a current medication list and run an interaction review against curated and OpenFDA sources — with explicit limits and a nudge to consult your pharmacist.
landing.features.assistant.title: Grounded AI assistant
landing.features.assistant.body: Ask questions about your reports. Answers cite your documents, admit when information is missing, and never invent diagnoses.
landing.features.family.title: Family health profiles
landing.features.family.body: Manage records for children, parents, and spouses in isolated profiles — each with its own documents, trends, and privacy controls.
landing.how.title: From paper pile to personal intelligence
landing.how.step1.title: Upload
landing.how.step1.body: Drop in a PDF or photo of any medical report. Files are validated, sized-checked, and stored privately.
landing.how.step2.title: Extract & review
landing.how.step2.body: OCR and structured extraction find tests, values, units, and ranges. You review and correct before anything is saved.
landing.how.step3.title: Understand & track
landing.how.step3.body: Read plain-language explanations, watch trends across reports, and ask the grounded assistant anything.
landing.security.title: Privacy is the product
landing.security.body: Health data deserves more than a promise. PARIKSHAN enforces ownership on the server, hashes passwords with scrypt, signs sessions, rate-limits sensitive endpoints, and never logs full medical documents. Every record carries its provenance.
landing.assistant.title: Ask your records anything
landing.assistant.note: Illustrative sample conversation — not a real user's data.

landing.cta.subtitle: Create a free account, or explore the labeled demo workspace first.

privacy.title: Privacy & data controls
privacy.subtitle: See exactly what is stored, and control its lifecycle.
privacy.retentionBody: Data is kept until you delete it. Deleting a document removes its file, extracted text, and linked observations. Deleting your account removes everything, including audit metadata.
privacy.sharingBody: Your records are never shared with other users, never used to train external models, and never exposed to search engines. AI providers (when configured) receive only the record excerpts needed to answer your question.
privacy.export: You can export or delete everything at any time from Settings.

landing.problem.title: Medical records are scattered, dense, and written for clinicians.
landing.problem.1.title: Fragmented
landing.problem.1.body: Reports live in WhatsApp forwards, lab portals, paper folders, and email attachments. Finding the last CBC is a scavenger hunt.
landing.problem.2.title: Opaque
landing.problem.2.body: “S. Creatinine 1.3 mg/dL (0.6–1.2)” tells you nothing unless you know what creatinine is, what the range means, and what changed since last year.
landing.problem.3.title: Disconnected
landing.problem.3.body: Family members' records are managed by whoever remembers the passwords, and trends across years are almost impossible to see.

landing.principles.title: Built to be trusted, not just admired.
landing.principles.1.title: Provenance over polish
landing.principles.1.body: Every value links back to the document, page, and range it came from. If we do not know, we say we do not know.
landing.principles.2.title: No invented certainty
landing.principles.2.body: No risk scores, no diagnoses, no fabricated trends. Missing data is shown as missing data.
landing.principles.3.title: Consent by construction
landing.principles.3.body: Family profiles require an explicit authorization affirmation. Ownership is enforced server-side on every request.
landing.principles.4.title: Bilingual by design
landing.principles.4.body: English and Hindi interfaces — while preserving every clinical term, value, and unit exactly as printed.
landing.demo.note: The demo includes fictional SAMPLE records so you can explore every feature without uploading real health data.
